data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that trims long text and toggles show more/less.
data.what_it_does: RichReadMoreText displays a piece of text and collapses it either by line count or character length. When the content exceeds the limit it shows a clickable toggle to expand or collapse the text.
use_when: You need a simple read‑more/less UI for long paragraphs
You want customizable styles and callbacks for the toggle
avoid_when: You require rich markdown rendering or complex text layout
You need animated transitions for expanding/collapsing
strengths: Easy to integrate with just one widget
Supports both TextSpan and plain String inputs
Customizable toggle text, styles, and callbacks
weaknesses: Only provides basic trimming, no advanced animations
Limited to text; not a full rich‑content solution

alternatives.name: auto_size_text
alternatives.why_pick_it: Fits text within a given space without needing a read‑more toggle, useful when you just want auto‑scaling rather than collapsing
